body:
Code Review by Qodo


1. Manual-only plans fail build review 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>The new build-reviewer rule requires an asserting test marked // covers: T<n> for every checklist
>line, including Manual: entries and the explicitly permitted no-test T0 entry. Once this
>reviewer prompt is in use, a valid plan for a change with nothing runnable receives a FAIL under
>rubric item 1; a Run: line containing only a non-test check such as typechecking has the same
>conflict.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The build reviewer rejects valid Manual and T0 checklist entries because it requires an asserting test for every T line. It also rejects non-test Run checks that the checklist parser accepts. >## Fix Focus Areas >- .claude/agents/build-reviewer.md[13-13] >- .claude/agents/pi-planner.md[27-31] >## Recommended Fix >Require a `// covers:` test only for Run entries that execute test files. Give Manual, T0, and non-test Run entries appropriate verification criteria instead. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/d619e206-72c9-4df9-9d8c-7d494b6fcfb9?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/d619e206-72c9-4df9-9d8c-7d494b6fcfb9)
2. PR body hides historical plan rejections 📎 Requirement gap
>
>Description >
> >
>The PR description contains only the closing reference, the how-to-test pointer, the source-plan
>link and the worker footer, and never reports how many of the last 20 posted plans the new
>plan-shape validator would reject. The new Test-checklist tests in scripts/lib/plan-shape.test.mjs
>exercise the validator only on synthetic fixtures, so the historical impact is never measured in the
>PR. Reviewers therefore cannot judge how much existing plan history the new format breaks before
>merge.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >Rule 4503410 requires the new plan-shape validator to be run over the last 20 posted plans, with the number it would reject reported in the PR body. The PR description currently has no such count. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- scripts/lib/plan-shape.mjs[213-217] >- scripts/lib/plan-shape.test.mjs[208-242] > >## Recommended Fix >Run `parsePlan` (via the CLI in `scripts/lib/plan-shape.mjs`) over the last 20 posted pipeline plan comments on the repository, without editing any existing plan. Count how many fail validation and list the failing plans by number. Add that count and the list to the PR description. Do not rewrite or repost any old plan. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/db69ac4b-70a2-4b4b-8c4c-5a8c8baedecf?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/db69ac4b-70a2-4b4b-8c4c-5a8c8baedecf)

View medium (2)
3. Blank commands pass plan validation 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>parseLine checks that backticks contain characters but does not check whether the extracted
>command is empty after trimming. A Run:  entry containing only spaces therefore passes
>parseChecklist and parsePlan, leaving an accepted plan with nothing executable for that check.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >A whitespace-only command inside backticks passes checklist and plan-shape validation. >## Fix Focus Areas >- scripts/lib/plan-checklist.mjs[25-29] >- scripts/lib/plan-checklist.test.mjs[23-30] >## Recommended Fix >After trimming the extracted Run command, return a validation error if it is empty. Add a whitespace-only command test through the parser. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/93388d56-577e-40c0-8cdf-85f1524e0553?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/93388d56-577e-40c0-8cdf-85f1524e0553)
4. Orphan comments count as test coverage 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>findCovers extracts IDs from any matching // covers: text without checking whether the comment
>is immediately above a test. An orphan comment or matching text inside a test file can therefore
>make coverageGaps treat a Run check as covered even when no test names it.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >Coverage extraction treats stray `covers:` text as a reverse link, so a checklist ID can appear covered without a marked test. >## Fix Focus Areas >- scripts/lib/plan-checklist.mjs[57-62] >- scripts/lib/plan-checklist.test.mjs[93-97] >## Recommended Fix >Extract IDs only from actual coverage comments immediately preceding test declarations, excluding string contents and orphan comments. Test those cases alongside a valid adjacent marker. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/1cae75f6-6295-4086-8382-dbe854899cae?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/1cae75f6-6295-4086-8382-dbe854899cae)
